owner_rule: Every named lexical definition and module statement has exactly ONE audit owner. Whole source supplied elsewhere is context only. Identical imports are CONDITIONAL on parent exact-byte comparison AND canonical-owner acceptance; omitted bodies are never passed.
lambdas_and_comments: Covered by their containing named-definition/module-statement owner; standalone comments are context, not independent behavior.
overall_acceptance: Requires guards+integration+tests accepted for these exact pins, every conditional import closed by parent, then separately authorized runtime qualification. Local slice acceptance never means full acceptance.
